scripts.test:postgres: uv run --locked pytest --postgres -m "postgres and not source_data"
scripts.lint: uv run --locked ruff check . && pnpm run lint:imports && pnpm run lint:boundaries && pnpm run lint:application && pnpm run lint:application:harness && pnpm run lint:domain && pnpm run lint:domain:harness && pnpm run lint:infrastructure && pnpm run lint:infrastructure:harness
scripts.lint:imports: cd .. && uv run --project backend --locked lint-imports --config backend/pyproject.toml
scripts.check: uv run --locked ruff check --fix . && uv run --locked ruff format .
scripts.typecheck: cd .. && uv run --project backend --locked mypy --config-file backend/pyproject.toml -p backend
scripts.build-data: cd .. && uv run --project backend --locked python -m backend.infrastructure.cli.structure_pmda_xml --source-dir data/pmda/originals
scripts.db:migrate: cd .. && uv run --project backend --locked python -m backend.infrastructure.cli.manage_postgres --database-env MEDI_CHAT_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL migrate
scripts.db:initialize: cd .. && uv run --project backend --locked python -m backend.infrastructure.cli.manage_postgres --database-env MEDI_CHAT_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL initialize --originals-dir data/pmda/originals
scripts.db:rebuild: cd .. && uv run --project backend --locked python -m backend.infrastructure.cli.manage_postgres --database-env MEDI_CHAT_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL rebuild --confirm-schema public
scripts.db:maintenance: cd .. && uv run --project backend --locked python -m backend.infrastructure.cli.manage_postgres --database-env MEDI_CHAT_DATABASE_URL maintenance
scripts.db:export: cd .. && uv run --project backend --locked python -m backend.infrastructure.cli.manage_postgres --database-env MEDI_CHAT_DATABASE_URL export
scripts.lint:domain: cd .. && uv run --project backend --locked python scripts/checks/domain_architecture.py
